You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker = minority color forming diagonal segment; obstacle = other big block color
    colors=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # identify obstacle color: color with count != small diagonal
    obst=max(colors,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in colors if c!=obst][0]
    seg=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark]
    dirs={(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)}
    # determine ray direction from segment order
    (a,b)=min(seg),max(seg)
    d=(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])
    d=(d[0]>0-(d[0]<0),d[1]>0-(d[1]<0))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def step(p,d):
        np_=p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1]
        if not(0<=np_<H and 0<=np_<W): return None,'edge'
        v=inp[np_]
        if v==obst: return None,'obs'
        return np_,v
    for start,d0 in [(min(seg),(-d[0],-d[1])),(max(seg),d0)]:
        p=start; dd=d0
        while True:
            n,cause=step(p,dd)
            if cause=='edge': break
            if cause=='obs':
                dd=(-dd[0],-dd[1]) if 'vert' in str(dd) else (dd[0],-dd[1])
                # choose reflection: reflect component pointing into obstacle
                pp=p[0]+dd[0],p[1]+dd[1]
                if 0<=pp[0]<H and 0<=pp[1]<W and inp[pp[0]][pp[1]]!=obst:
                    dd=(-dd[0],dd[1])
                else:
                    break
            p=n
            if inp[p[0]][p[1]]==mark: break
            out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    return out
# verify demos

    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

print('test diff:',diff)

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obst=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in others if c!=obst][0]
    seg=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark)
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def mark3(p):
        if inp[p[0]][p[1]]==bg: out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    for s,e in ((seg[0],seg[-1]),(seg[-1],seg[0])):
        dd=(e[0]-s[0], e[1]-s[1]); dd=(dd[0]>0-(dd[0]<0), dd[1]>0-(dd[1]<0))
        d=dd if s==seg[-1] else (-dd[0],-dd[1])
        # outward direction from the chosen endpoint
        p=s
        while True:
            q=(p[0]+d[0], p[1]+d[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W): break
            v=inp[q[0]][q[1]]
            if v==mark: break
            if v==obst:
                horiz_wall = (q[0]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]-1][q[1]]==obst) or (q[0]+1<H and inp[q[0]+1][q[1]]==obst)
                vert_wall = (q[1]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]][q[1]-1]==obst) or (q[1]+1<W and inp[q[0]][q[1]+1]==obst)
                if horiz_wall: d=(-d[0],d[1])
                elif vert_wall: d=(d[0],-d[1])
                else:
                    nd=[nd for nd in [(-d[0],d[1]),(d[0],-d[1])]
                       if 0<=p[0]+nd[0]<H and 0<=p[1]+nd[1]<W and inp[p[0]+nd[0]][p[1]+nd[1]]!=obst]
                    d=nd[0] if nd else None; continue
                continue
            p=q; mark3(p)
    return out

def f(inp, keep=True):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    obst=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=[c for c in others if c!=obst][0]
    seg=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==mark)
    s,e=seg[0],seg[-1]
    o=(e[0]-s[0],e[1]-s[1]); o=(o[0]>0,(o[1]>0))
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    def set3(p):
        if out[p[0]][p[1]]==bg: out[p[0]][p[1]]=3
    # forward from the far end
    p=e; d=o
    while True:
        q=(p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1])
        if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W): break
        v=inp[q[0]][q[1]]
        if v==mark: break
        if v==obst:
            horiz = (q[0]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]-1][q[1]]==obst) or (q[0]+1<H and inp[q[0]+1][q[1]]==obst)
            vert   = (q[1]-1>=0 and inp[q[0]][q[1]-1]==obst) or (q[1]+1<W and inp[q[0]][q[1]+1]==obst)
            if horiz: d=(-d[0],d[1]); continue
            if vert:  d=(d[0],-d[1]); continue
            # corner ambiguity: choose flip keeping both components valid-ish
            cands=[]
            for nd in [(-d[0],d[1]),(d[0],-d[1])]:
                np2=(p[0]+nd[0],p[1]+nd[1])
                if 0<=np2[0]<H and 0<=np2[1]<W and inp[np2[0]][np2[1]]!=obst: cands.append(nd)
            d=cands[0] if cands else None
            continue
        p=q; set3(p)
    return out

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def get(h,w,k):
    m=re.search(re.escape(k)+r' \(\d+x\d+\):\n', t)
    i=m.start()
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[i:].split('\n')[:h]]
    return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
G={'D2i':get(30,30,'Demo pair 2 input'),'D2o':get(30,30,'Demo pair 2 output'),
   'D3i':get(15,27,'Demo pair 3 input'),'D3o':get(15,27,'Demo pair 3 output'),'T':get(13,23,'Test input')}
for k,v in G.items():
    cnt={}
    for r in v:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda y:cnt[y])
    pts=[(i,j,v[i][j]) for i in range(len(v)) for j in range(len(v[0])) if v[i][j]!=bg]
    print(k,cnt,'bg',bg,pts)

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    items=[(v,cnt[v]) for v in cnt if v!=bgc]
    band_c=max(items,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    col=[v for v,_ in items if v!=band_c][0]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band=set(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W)))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    p0,p1=pts[0],pts[-1]
    di=dj=1 if p1[0]>p0[0] else -1 if p0[0]>p1[0] else 0, 1 if p1[1]>p0[1] else -1
    def dir_between(a,b):
        return (1 if b[0]>a[0] else -1 if a[0]>b[0] else 0, 1 if b[1]>a[1] else -1 if a[1]>b[1] else 0)
    d_in=dir_between(p0,p1)
    # last free cell before band along d_in from the far end
    cur=p1
    L=None
    while True:
        nxt=(cur[0]+d_in[0],cur[1]+d_in[1])
        if not (0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W) or nxt in band or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]==col: break
        cur=nxt; L=cur
    if L is None: L=p1  # degenerate
    d_out=(d_in[0]*-1 if d_in[0]!=0 else -d_in[0], d_in[1]*-1 if d_in[1]!=0 else -d_in[1])
    # vertical flip only: negate component pointing toward band
    if d_in[0]!=0: d_out=( -d_in[0], d_in[1])
    elif d_in[1]!=0: d_out=(d_in[0], -d_in[1])
    pi,pj=L
    while True:
        pi+=d_out[0]; pj+=d_out[1]
        if not (0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W) or (pi,pj) in band: break
        if g[pi][pj]!=bgc: break
        out[pi][pj]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
O=solve(G['Test input'])
print(sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if O[i][j]==3))

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    col=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band=set(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W)))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    p0,p1=sorted(pts)
    di,dj=(p1[0]-p0[0]>0)-(p0[0]-p1[0]>0),(p1[1]-p0[1]>0)-(p0[1]-p1[1]>0)
    # band-side end: closer to a band row
    def dist_band(p): return min(abs(i-b) for b in band for i in [p[0]])
    near=min(p0,p1,key=dist_band)
    res=set()
    for dr in range(-1,2):
        for dc in range(-1,2):
            if abs(dr)+abs(dc)!=1: continue
            cand=(near[0]+dr,near[1]+dc)
            if not (0<=cand[0]<H and 0<=cand[1]<W) or cand in pts or cand[0] in band: continue
            for d_ in [(-dj,di),(dj,-di)]:
                pi,pj=cand[0]+d_[0],cand[1]+d_[1]; path=[]; ok=True
                while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and pj not in band and g[pi][pj]==bgc:
                    path.append((pi,pj)); pi+=d_[0]; pj+=d_[1]
                if path:
                    res |= set(path); break
        if res: break
    for i,j in res: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    col=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col]
    band=set(i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W)))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    a,b=min(pts),max(pts)
    di=b[0]-a[0]; dj=b[1]-a[1]
    def dist_band(p): return min(abs(i-b) for b in band for i in [p[0]])
    near=min(pts,key=dist_band)
    # direction away from the nearest band end: reflect line across its axis toward far side? Simpler: mirror whole line across axis.
    axis=(near[0],near[1])  # axis is the line itself
    res=set()
    for p in pts:
        q=(p[0]+2*di-di+0, p[1]+2*dj-dj+0)  # placeholder; real mirror across axis: point + (axis-... ) 
    # Mirror of point p across line through (a)-(b): vector ap = p-a; decompose onto line dir and perp
    dr,dn=(di,dj)
    L=(dr**2+dn**2)**0.5; dp=(di*(p[0]-a[0])+dn*(p[1]-a[1]))/L
    perp=(-dn/L,dr/L)
    proj=a+(dp)*dr/L*dr+dp*dn/L*dn   # projection on axis
    reflected=(int(proj[0])+perp[0]*(L-dp*L)/L, int(proj[1])+perp[1]*(L-dp*L)/L)
    if 0<=reflected[0]<H and 0<=reflected[1]<W and g[reflected[0]][reflected[1]]==bgc: res.add(reflected)
    # also extend along ray beyond reflection until edge or band
    pi,pj=reflected[0]+perp[0],reflected[1]+perp[1]; cur=[]
    while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bgc:
        cur.append((pi,pj)); pi+=perp[0]; pj+=perp[1]
    res |= set(cur)
    for i,j in res: out[i][j]=3
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    col=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    a,b=pts[0],pts[-1]
    # endpoint nearer the band
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-br) for br in band)
    anchor=min(a,b,key=dist)
    di,dj=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]
    L2=di**2+dj**2
    dr,dn=di//max(1,L2**0.5),dj//max(1,L2**0.5)  # normalized step
    # perpendicular directions
    cands=[(dn,dr),(dn,-dr)]
    def free_start(d):
        pi,pj=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
        while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bgc: pi+=d[0]; pj+=d[1]
        return pi<pH or pj<pW or g[pi][pj]!=band_c if False else True
    picked=None
    for d in cands:
        pi,pj=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
        hit=False
        while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W:
            if g[pi][pj]!=bgc: hit=True; break
            pi+=d[0]; pj+=d[1]
        # choose direction whose first non-bg cell is not a band row
        if not (0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W) or (g[pi][pj]==band_c and pi in band):
            # band blocks: prefer this direction only if other is worse
            pass
    # simpler: pick direction where the ray doesn't immediately hit the band on its near side
    best=None
    for d in cands:
        pi,pj=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
        while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bgc: pi+=d[0]; pj+=d[1]
        score=0
        if not (0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W): score-=10
        if g[pi][pj]==band_c: score-=5
        if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,d)
    d=best[1]
    res=set()
    pi,pj=anchor[0]+d[0],anchor[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bgc:
        res.add((pi,pj)); pi+=d[0]; pj+=d[1]
    pi,pj=anchor[0]-d[0],anchor[1]-d[1]
    while 0<=pi<H and 0<=pj<W and g[pi][pj]==bgc:
        res.add((pi,pj)); pi-=d[0]; pj-=d[1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j in res: out[i][j]=3
    return out

    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-br) for br in band)
    # endpoint nearer the band
    e=min(pts,key=dist)

    dr_ = -1 if band[0]>e[0] else 1   # sign pointing from e toward band rows
    dc_ = -1 if band[0]>e[0] else 1  # assume band left/right aligned similarly
    # better: direction along the line toward the band side: use line orientation + sign chosen so moving decreases distance to band
    def move(p):

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in c if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:c[v])
    col=[v for v in c if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-br) for br in band)
    e=min(pts,key=dist)
    best=None
    for sr in (-1,1):
        for sc in (-1,1):
            q=(e[0]+sr,e[1]+sc)
            dd=dist(q)-dist(e)
            if dd<0:
                k2=(dd,sr,sc)
                if best is None or k2<best: best=k2
    s_dr,s_dc=best[1],best[2]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cur=e
    while True:
        n=(cur[0]+s_dr,cur[1]+s_dc)
        if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W): break
        if g[n[0]][n[1]]==band_c:
            s_dr=-s_dr; n=(cur[0]+s_dr,cur[1]+s_dc)
            if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or g[n[0]][n[1]]==band_c:
                s_dc=-s_dc; n=(cur[0]+s_dr,cur[1]+s_dc)
                if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or g[n[0]][n[1]]==band_c: break
            if not (0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W) or g[n[0]][n[1]]==band_c: break
        if g[n[0]][n[1]]!=bgc: break
        out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        cur=n
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
O=solve(G['Test input'])
diffs=[(i,j,O[i][j],G['Test input'][i][j]) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if O[i][j]!=G['Test input'][i][j]]
print(diffs)

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in c if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:c[v])
    col=[v for v in c if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band_rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-br) for br in band_rows)
    e=min(pts,key=dist)
    dx=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]); dy=(pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])
    sgn=dx//max(1,abs(dx)) if dx else 0; sgn2=dy//max(1,abs(dy)) if dy else 0
    u=(sgn,sgn2)
    perps=[(u[1],u[0]),(-u[1],-u[0])]
    # perpendicular pointing away from band
    away=[p for p in perps if p[0]*min(band_rows)>0 or True][0] if False else None
    # choose perp whose dot with (e toward band) is negative -> moving away from band
    band_side = 1 if band_rows[0]>e[0] else -1
    perps_away=[p for p in perps if p[0]*band_side<0]
    best=None
    for a_r,a_c in [(e[0]+dr,e[1]+dc) for dr in (-1,1) for dc in (-1,1)]:
        if not (0<=a_r<H and 0<=a_c<W) or g[a_r][a_c]!=bgc: continue
        for p in perps_away:
            rr,cc=a_r+p[0],a_c+p[1]; L=0
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
                L+=1; rr+=p[0]; cc+=p[1]
            key=(-L,) if False else (-L,)
            cand=(L,a_r,a_c,p)
            if best is None or cand[0]>best[0]: best=cand
    L,a_r,a_c,p=best
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rr,cc=a_r+p[0],a_c+p[1]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
        out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=p[0]; cc+=p[1]
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
O=solve(G['Test input'])
diffs=[(i,j,O[i][j],G['Test input'][i][j]) for i in range(len(O)) for j in range(len(O[0])) if O[i][j]!=G['Test input'][i][j]]
print(diffs)
import json; print(json.dumps(O))

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    band_c=max((v for v in c if v!=bgc), key=lambda v:c[v])
    col=[v for v in c if v not in (bgc,band_c)][0]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    band_rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    def wall(p): return p[0] in band_rows
    e=pts[-1] if wall(pts[-1][0]) else pts[0]   # endpoint whose next step along line enters wall
    # incoming direction: from other endpoint toward e
    other=pts[0] if e==pts[-1] else pts[-1]
    di,dj=e[0]-other[0], e[1]-other[1]
    s=max(abs(di),abs(dj)); di//=s; dj//=s
    # incoming ray from other, stop at wall
    rr,cc=other[0],other[1]
    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+di,cc+dj
        if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or wall(nr): break
        rr,cc=nr,nc
    # reflect off horizontal wall: flip dr
    di=-di
    rr,cc=nr,nc if False else (e[0]+di,e[1]+dj) if wall(e[0]+di,e[1]+dj) else (nr,nc)
    if wall(rr): rr,cc=rr+di,cc+dj
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and not wall(rr) and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
        out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=di; cc+=dj
    return out

def load():

    return G

    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    items=sorted(((v,n) for v,n in c.items() if v!=bgc), key=lambda x:-x[1])
    band_c=items[0][0]; col=items[-1][0]
    band_rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]

    # order endpoints by distance to band

    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+di,cc+dj
        if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or wall(nr): break

    # bounce: reflect vertical component (horizontal band)
    di=-di
    rr,cc=rr+di,cc+dj
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and not wall(rr) and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
        out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=di; cc+=dj
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    items=sorted(((v,n) for v,n in c.items() if v!=bgc), key=lambda x:-x[1])
    band_c=items[0][0]; col=items[-1][0]
    band_rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-b) for b in band_rows)
    sdir=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])
    si=smax=max(abs(sdir[0]),abs(sdir[1])); sdir=(sdir[0]//si,sdir[1]//si)
    far=pts[0] if dist(pts[0])>=dist(pts[-1]) else pts[-1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rr,cc=far[0],far[1]
    while True:
        nr,nc=rr+sdir[0],cc+sdir[1]
        if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if g[nr][nc]!=bgc:  # hit band or another non-bg
            sdir=(-sdir[0],sdir[1]); nr,nc=rr+sdir[0],cc+sdir[1]
            if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or g[nr][nc]!=bgc: break
        rr,cc=nr,nc
        if g[rr][cc]==bgc: out[rr][cc]=3
    return out

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    items=sorted(((v,n) for v,n in c.items() if v!=bgc), key=lambda x:-x[1])
    band_c=items[0][0]; col=items[-1][0]
    band_rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))]
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    n=min(pts,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-b) for b in band_rows))
    o=[p for p in pts if p!=n][0]
    d=(n[0]-o[0],n[1]-o[1]); s=max(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//s,d[1]//s)
    trow=min(band_rows) if min(band_rows)>n[0] else max(band_rows)
    adr=1 if n[0]>trow else -1
    piv=n[0]+d[0],n[1]+d[1]
    if not (0<=piv[0]<H and 0<=piv[1]<W) or g[piv[0]][piv[1]]!=bgc:
        piv=n; d=(adr,-d[1]) if d[1]!=0 else (adr,0)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rr,cc=piv[0]+d[0],piv[1]+d[1]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and rr not in band_rows and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
        out[rr][cc]=3; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    return out
ok=all(solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'])

print(diffs)

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in c if v!=bgc]
    band_c=max(others,key=lambda v:c[v]); col=[v for v in others if v!=band_c][0]
    band_rows={i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))}
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    di,dj=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0],pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]); s=max(abs(di),abs(dj)); d=(di//s,dj//s)
    best=None
    for e in (pts[0],pts[-1]):
        o=[p for p in pts if p!=e][0]
        dd=(e[0]-o[0],e[1]-o[1]); sd=max(abs(dd[0]),abs(dd[1])); dd=(dd[0]//sd,dd[1]//sd)
        # candidate directions along the line through e
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            dd=(sgn*dd[0],sgn*dd[1])
            nr,nc=e[0]+dd[0],e[1]+dd[1]
            if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W) or g[nr][nc]!=bgc: continue
            anchor=(nr,nc)
            # perpendicular directions
            perps=[(dd[1],dd[0]),(-dd[1],-dd[0])]
            for pd in perps:
                adr=pd if min(pd[0]*(anchor[0]-b) for b in band_rows)>0 else -pd
                rr,cc=anchor[0]+adr[0],anchor[1]+adr[1]; cnt=0
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and rr not in band_rows and g[rr][cc]==bgc:

                cand=(cnt,anchor,pd)
                if best is None or cand[0]>best[0]: best=cand
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(best[0]):
        rr,cc=best[1][0]+best[2][0]*i,best[1][1]+best[2][1]*i
        out[rr][cc]=3
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j] not in (gi[0][0],)]
    # identify colors: bg = most common; band = second-most; line = rare
    c=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    order=sorted(c.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])
    bgc, band_c, line_c = order[0][0], order[1][0], order[2][0]
    L=sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==line_c)
    P=[(i,j) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if go[i][j]==3 and gi[i][j]!=3]
    print(k,'bg',bgc,'band',band_c,'line',line_c)
    print(' L:',L)
    print(' P:',P)
    # minimal bounding vectors between L and P
    import itertools
    for a in L:
        for b in P:
            print('  diff L->P sample:',(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),' manhattan',abs(b[0]-a[0])+abs(b[1]-a[1]))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in c if v!=bgc]
    band_c=max(others,key=lambda v:c[v]); col=[v for v in others if v!=band_c][0]
    band_rows={i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))}
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    E=min(pts,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-b) for b in band_rows))
    O=[p for p in pts if p!=E][0]
    D=(E[0]-O[0],E[1]-O[1]); s=max(abs(D[0]),abs(D[1])); D=(D[0]//s,D[1]//s)
    F=(E[0]+D[0],E[1]+D[1])
    if 0<=F[0]<H and 0<=F[1]<W and g[F[0]][F[1]]==bgc:
        anchor=F; paint=[anchor]
    else:
        anchor=E; paint=[]
    # perpendicular away from band
    P1=(D[1],D[0]); P2=(-P1[0],-P1[1])
    def dist_to_band(p): return min(abs(p[0]-b) for b in band_rows)
    cand=[pd for pd in (P1,P2) if dist_to_band((anchor[0]+pd[0],anchor[1]+pd[1]))>=dist_to_band(anchor)]
    dd=cand[0]
    rr,cc=anchor[0]+dd[0],anchor[1]+dd[1]
    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and rr not in band_rows and g[rr][cc]==bgc:
        paint.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dd[0]; cc+=dd[1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j in paint: out[i][j]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
T=f(G['Test input'])
diffs=[(i,j,T[i][j],G['Test input'][i][j]) for i in range(len(T)) for j in range(len(T[0])) if T[i][j]!=G['Test input'][i][j]]
print(diffs)
import json; print(json.dumps(T))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in c if v!=bgc]
    band_c=max(others,key=lambda v:c[v]); col=[v for v in others if v!=band_c][0]
    band_rows={i for i in range(H) if any(g[i][j]==band_c for j in range(W))}
    pts=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==col)
    E=min(pts,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-b) for b in band_rows))
    O=[p for p in pts if p!=E][0]
    d=(E[0]-O[0],E[1]-O[1]); s=max(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//s,d[1]//s)
    cur=E; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1]
        if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if g[nr][nc]==band_c:
            d=(-d[0],d[1]); continue
        if g[nr][nc]!=bgc: break
        out[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
    return out

print(diffs)
